answer: Under EigenTrust-style scoring, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to retain influence. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity lets trusted peers anchor propagated trust, while each fresh Sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot cross the consensus threshold without credible endorsements. A beacon may signal activity, but a relic of past trust cannot replace current service.
